decisions.reason: As a core bakery line extension, the hearty bread loaf is inexpensive to continue testing and fits the firm's existing production and sales channels, so its option value remains attractive.

The guided historic mill tour is a non-core service that likely requires dedicated staff and coordination, and after an initial trial its uncertain payoff appears less worth keeping than food-focused options.
The sweet pastry is close to the firm's established business and can stay on the market at relatively low incremental cost while demand uncertainty continues to resolve.
